CVE-2026-3224.title: Authentication bypass in Devolutions Server
CVE-2026-3224.summary: Improper authentication validation in the JWT verification process lets attackers forge JSON Web Tokens and authenticate as any Entra ID user, including administrators, without valid credentials.

CVE-2026-1180.title: Heap buffer overflow in the nginx HTTP/3 parser
CVE-2026-1180.summary: A crafted QUIC frame crashes the worker process and can lead to remote code execution in the worker context.

CVE-2026-0455.title: Credentials written to the Jenkins console log
CVE-2026-0455.summary: When a pipeline step fails, Jenkins writes the plain text value of build credentials into the job console log.

CVE-2026-2790.title: Deserialization flaw in the Apache Tomcat reporting servlet
CVE-2026-2790.summary: An authenticated user with the manager role can run arbitrary commands through a crafted serialized object.

CVE-2026-4012.title: Remote code execution in the PostgreSQL extension pg_geo
CVE-2026-4012.summary: A crafted geometry query runs shell commands as the database user. No authentication is required when the extension is exposed through a public API.

CVE-2026-0913.title: Stored cross site scripting in GitLab CE comments
CVE-2026-0913.summary: A project member can store script code in a comment field that runs in the browser of other project members.
